fields.description:
Same treatment as BUILD-131, applied to Partner.

=== FIELDS ===

* Section: All Additional Information, inside a More Info tab

* Partner External ID — Text(80), External ID, case-insensitive. Created by Marc Aug 13; replaces auto-number Partner_ID__c.

* Partner Code — Text. Note: partner codes are the suffixes in CMS link names — Joyce, Aug 11: 'They just exist as second part of the link name so CTM for drafkings-CTM.'

* Partner Aliases — Long Text Area, semicolon-delimited

* Logo URL — URL

* Partner Notes — Long Text Area (main page, not the tab)

* Created By / Last Modified By — standard, no build

=== IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS ===

* Check whether the Partner page already has a tab component, as Operator did. If not, create one.

* P&L Book Name and CMS Last Sync are deliberately NOT created — same as BUILD-131.

* Tab visibility only — NOT field-level security. The mockup flags this section 'Hidden from Ops by field-level security', but that is not what is being built. Decided 2026-08-17: 'Tab visibility is sufficient.' No profile or permission-set work in this card. 'Ops' in the mockup also doesn't map cleanly to the Rep/Manager/Ops permission model, which is a second reason not to read it literally.

* Do not build the error/audit log view — it gets scoped with the CMS integration work.

=== OPEN QUESTIONS ===

* Same 'squash' ambiguity as BUILD-131 — Taryn to rewatch \~36:00 of the Aug 13 recording and confirm whether Joyce meant delete the System section or only the Owner field.

=== NOTES ===

* Outstanding.

* Provenance: PT-5. The 'Active Status' duplicate that lived here is deleted — see BUILD-136.

=== SOURCE ===

* Taryn doc PT-5

* Aug 13 call

* Slack Marc Aug 13 23:33

* Aug 17 Marc call — layout read-only, not FLS

Dependencies: BUILD-136

Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer

Remember to update the requirements documentation as part of this change.

Created 2026-08-17 from the Operator/Partner ticket review, approved by Kobi.

comments.body: Not yet built, per this ticket's own notes — on the outstanding list. P&L Book Name, CMS Last Sync, and an error/audit log view are excluded per spec.
